intro: Every trip leaves behind a different way of seeing. Here they are grouped by destination — hover over each group to read its story.

trips.name: Spain
trips.subtitle: Madrid · Asturias · Segovia · Barcelona
trips.text: Home. From the high plains to the Cantabrian Sea: the familiar, seen as if for the first time.

trips.name: Italian Lakes
trips.subtitle: Italy
trips.text: Sunsets over the water and villages clinging to the mountainside.

trips.name: Europe
trips.subtitle: Amsterdam · Berlin · Budapest
trips.text: City escapes: canals, domes and façades mirrored in the water.

trips.name: East Coast
trips.subtitle: New York · Washington D.C.
trips.text: Skyscrapers, bridges and lights that never go out.

trips.name: California
trips.subtitle: San Francisco · Sausalito · Yosemite · San Diego
trips.text: From the fog of the Bay to the beaches of the south, by way of Yosemite’s granite.

trips.name: The Southwest
trips.subtitle: Grand Canyon · Antelope Canyon
trips.text: Red rock, light that cuts like a blade, and a scale no photograph can hold.

trips.name: Islands
trips.subtitle: Hawaii · Puerto Rico
trips.text: Waterfalls in the jungle, fire in the Pacific night and palm trees leaning over the Caribbean.

trips.name: Unsorted
trips.subtitle: Not yet placed
trips.text: Loose photographs still waiting for a trip.
